name: EntityHandle
lead: A body the world moves: a pack's own entity, a mob, a stack on the ground. Every read is a fresh look at the world, so a handle to something that has died reads `nil`. Inside a hook the same handle reads the entity as it was at the top of the tick, and its writes land at that hook's own slot.

functions.name: play
functions.description: Model size: reads vec3; write a positive number or equal-axis vec3. Nil without a model. Plays a model entity's animation from the start; on the one already playing, `speed` only changes its speed.

functions.name: stop
functions.description: Stops a model entity's animation; the parts stay where they are.

functions.name: move
functions.description: Gone on the next tick. Sets position and optional rotation together.

functions.name: push
functions.description: A shove, in blocks a tick, added to what it is already doing.

functions.name: settle
functions.description: It stops being an entity and is a block again where it stands. No argument: the entity remembers what it was.

functions.name: nearby
functions.description: What else is around it, by horizontal distance.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Its entity id, the one players.on_click reports in `hit.entity_id`.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The kind's name: "cow", "rave:rocket". Nil once it is gone.

fields.name: alive
fields.description: Whether it is still in the world. A hook only runs for one that is.

fields.name: velocity
fields.description: Where it is, live; writing it is a teleport. Nil once it is gone. Partial writes preserve other angles; nil after removal. Bodies have no roll. How it is moving, live; writing it is steering by hand. Nil once it is gone. writing it is steering by hand

fields.name: on_ground
fields.description: Whether it stands on something. Nil once it is gone.

fields.name: health
fields.description: Its health now. Nil once it is gone.

fields.name: max_health
fields.description: The most health its kind gives it. Nil for an entity that is not a mob and once it is gone. Read-only.

fields.name: hostile
fields.description: Whether its kind is hostile. Nil once it is gone.

fields.name: physics
fields.description: Which order of operations moves it: "vehicle", "living", "falling", "item" or "none".

fields.name: origin
fields.description: The block it used to be, for anything that arrived through a transition; nil for anything that was never a block.

fields.name: data
fields.description: A pack-defined entity's attached record. Nested edits write through. Saved with persist = "save". Built-in entities raise an error on access. on_steer/on_tick views expire after the callback batch; copy to keep a snapshot.

fields.name: forward
fields.description: The intent fields: what a body *wants* to do, which is what steering is. Writing one outside `on_steer` lasts until the next decision.

fields.name: strafe
fields.description: Intent: 1 left, -1 right. A vehicle's seat 1 writes it from the keys every tick.

fields.name: jumping
fields.description: Intent: whether it wants to jump. A vehicle's seat 1 writes it from the keys every tick.

fields.name: flying
fields.description: Intent, a living body with can_fly only: true flies (no gravity; forward moves it along its look, pitch included), false falls and walks. Setting it true on another body is an error.

fields.name: driver
fields.description: Whether it is in water now. False for an entity that is not alive. The player supplying driving input from seat 1; nil for an NPC or empty seat.

fields.name: paint
fields.description: Every occupant by seat number, including NPCs; nil means empty. Material name to colour; write-only.

title: EntityHandle type
